svg.title: JobCore jobAgent system architecture
svg.desc: Two-container architecture: jobFinderAgent with 5 LLM sub-agents for job search, and jobApplyAgent with Selenium-based form automation, both orchestrated by a Flask REST API

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Tell me about the JobCore React frontend')
sendPrompt('How does api.py handle routing, CORS and sessions?')
sendPrompt('Explain how conversationalAgent.py routes queries using keyword detection and LLM intent analysis')
sendPrompt('Walk me through all 5 agents in the jobAgent.py pipeline in detail')
sendPrompt('How does the Google Jobs scraper and LinkedIn scraper work?')
sendPrompt('What does Apply URL Agent A (applyUrlAgents.py) do exactly?')
sendPrompt('What does Apply URL Agent B (applyUrlAgents.py) do exactly?')
sendPrompt('How does agent_router.py use LangGraph to route between job_search and resume_checker?')
sendPrompt('How does google_form_apply.py automate Google Form submissions using Selenium?')
sendPrompt('How does interactive_google_form.py handle step-by-step Q&A, Gmail login, and file uploads?')
g.text: Step-by-step Q&A · Gmail login · file upload

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How does profile_resolver.py map user profile data to form field answers?')
g.text: Maps user profile data to form field answers

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How does state.py manage sessions in jobApplyAgent?')
sendPrompt('How is OpenAI used across all the agents?')
sendPrompt('How does the scraper pull data from Google Jobs?')
sendPrompt('How does jobApplyAgent interact with Google Forms and Gmail for login and submission?')
